blocks.text: Swiss chocolatier Läderach has opened its third chocolaterie in the Philippines at SM Megamall, located on the ground floor of the Mega Fashion Hall. The new store brings the brand’s Swiss chocolate creations to shoppers at one of Metro Manila’s leading fashion and lifestyle destinations. A Selection of Fresh Swiss Chocolate Creations At the heart of the Läderach experience is the FrischSchoggi, the brand’s signature fresh chocolate. Displayed in generous slabs, it is broken by hand according to each customer’s preference.
